# drL IPTV Player

> drL IPTV Player, kullanıcının kendi M3U oynatma listesini veya Xtream Codes bilgilerini Android telefon, tablet ve Android TV'de oynatan modern bir medya oynatıcıdır; uygulama hiçbir kanal, film veya dizi içeriği sunmaz ve satmaz.
> drL IPTV Player is a modern media player for Android phones, tablets, and Android TV that plays the user's own M3U playlists or Xtream Codes credentials; the app does not provide or sell any channels, movies, or series content.

## Key Facts (Temel Bilgiler)
- **Exact Name**: drL IPTV Player
- **Package ID**: `com.drl.iptvplayer`
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.drl.iptvplayer
- **Developer**: drL Yazılım
- **Contact**: dereliticaret61@gmail.com
- **Supported Platforms**: Android Phone, Android Tablet, Android TV / Google TV (Android OS devices only)
- **Content Policy**: Does NOT provide, host, or sell any TV channels, movies, series, or playlists. Users must supply their own legal M3U or Xtream Codes source.
- **Account & Privacy**: No registration or account required. Playlist credentials are encrypted locally on the device via Android Keystore and never sent to developer servers.
- **Monetization**: Free to download (supported by Google AdMob with EEA/UK/Switzerland UMP consent). Optional Premium subscription via Google Play Billing unlocks ad-free playback, Catch-up (on supported providers), and Multi-Screen.

## Core Features (Özellikler)
- M3U / M3U8 URL and Xtream Codes API playback
- Multiple playlists and family user profiles
- Live TV, Movies (VOD), and Series categories with fast search, favorites, and resume playback
- QR Code TV Pairing: Send playlists or streams from phone to Android TV over local Wi-Fi (protected by a 6-digit PIN) without typing long URLs on a remote control
- Chromecast / Google Cast support with built-in local proxy for HLS/CORS compatibility and manual IP connection fallback
- Parental Control (PIN-protected adult content filter)
- Electronic Program Guide (EPG), Sleep Timer, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), selectable audio/subtitles
- Full Android TV D-pad remote support and Lite Mode for low-end devices
